Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc-Lko:54714
Court No. - 16
Case :- Criminal Misc Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No. - 1822 of 2023

Applicant :- Smt. Farah S. Ahmed
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

Counsel for Applicant :- Arun Sinha,Ram Chandra Singh Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.
1. Heard Sri Arun Sinha, the learned counsel for the applicant as well as Sri Surya Prakash, the learned Additional Government Advocate appearing on behalf of the State and perused the records.

2. The instant application has been filed by the applicant seeking anticipatory bail in F.I.R. bearing Case Crime No.22 of 2021, under Sections 147, 148, 149, 323, 504, 506, 420, 467, 468, 471, 120B I.P.C., registered at Police Station Wazirganj, District Lucknow.

entities.text: F.I.R. bearing Case Crime No.22 of 2021
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: 3. The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of an F.I.R. lodged on 19.01.2021 against five named persons, including the applicant, and 40-50 unknown persons in furtherance of an application under Section 156(3) Cr.P.C. alleging that the informant is owner of a particular piece of property and co-accused Siraj Sartaj Durrani falsely claiming himself to be owner of the property executed power of attorney in favour of the applicant, which was registered in the office of Sub Registrar on 04.10.2019.
Informant has not disclosed the date of execution of sale deed in his favour Smt. Farah S. Ahmed vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

1 by which he became owner of the property.

4. In the affidavit filed in support of the anticipatory bail-application, it has been contended that the applicant is 52 years old innocent woman having no criminal history and she has falsely been implicated in the present case.
5. The applicant and her husband had filed Writ Petition No.3599(MB) of 2021 before this Court and this Court
by means of the order dated 08.02.2021 stayed their arrest till submission of police report under Section 173(2) Cr.P.C.

6. Learned counsel for the applicant has drawn attention of this Court towards a copy of relevant extract of the case diary annexed as annexure-7 to the affidavit wherein the investigating officer has recorded that the applicant's complicity in commission of the offence could not be established from the material collected during the investigation and she has been wrongly implicated.

However,
subsequently, the investigating officer has submitted charge-sheet on 02.06.2022 including the name of the applicant as an accused but he expunged the name of her husband -Abrar Ahmad.
6. The learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail but he could not dispute the aforesaid aspects of the matter.

7. Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the fact that even as per the allegations in the FIR neither the title in respect of the property in question was transferred in favour of the applicant nor is it alleged in exercise of power conferred upon her through power of attorney the applicant had transferred ownership of the property or has created any encumbrance; that earlier the Investigating Officer himself had recorded that there was no material to establish applicant's complicity in commission of any offence; that a Suit No.1140 of 2020 for declaration of permanent injunction regarding property in question is pending in the Court of Civil Judge, Senior Division, Lucknow and that the applicant is a woman having no criminal history, and without making any observations which may affect the outcome of the case, I am of the view that the aforesaid facts are sufficient for making out a case for granting anticipatory bail to the applicant.
8. In view of the above, the anticipatory bail application of the applicant is allowed.
